title: Add the supplied Auritus logo and newsprint brand lockup
description: Apply the supplied logo beside the Auritus wordmark, add the BE HEARD tagline, refine the landing-page palette for a readable newsprint direction, and retain automatic whole-page light and dark modes.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Leaving this in progress. Unrelated to the TTS/player stopping point; logo/newsprint lockup is still the open product chore on the initiative.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
Picked this up after the previous session was cut short. What landed, on
branch `feat/newsprint-brand-lockup` (not yet merged):

**Lockup.** The engraving was in a 3.2rem circle with `object-fit: cover`,
which cropped off the bullhorn — the subject of the mark — and set a white
JPEG disc on the cream page. Knocked the background out into a flat-ink
alpha PNG (`auritus-announcer.png`, 512px, generated from the JPEG with
luminance as alpha so the crosshatch antialiases against the paper),
dropped the circle, and ran it at 6.4rem overhanging the header baseline
like a masthead cut. Moved it left of the wordmark so the bullhorn points
into "Auritus" rather than off the page edge. Dark mode inverts it to
white linework; mobile steps down to 5rem.

**Wordmark.** Tilted the "Auritus. / BE HEARD" block -7deg about its left
edge (`transform-origin: 0 50%`) and lifted it onto the bell's axis, so it
reads as being shouted out of the horn. The pivot is what sells it — the
end nearest the bell stays put and the block hinges out of it. -5deg read
as a rendering accident, -8deg got unstable for a lockup. `transform` does
not affect layout, so header height and nav are untouched.

**D2 palette.** The theme overrides were already in the `.d2` sources but
nothing had re-rendered, so the committed SVGs were still theme 6 "Grape
soda" purple and theme 200 Catppuccin. Re-rendered with the pinned d2
v0.7.1. Checked all 19 overridden slots against every colour both themes
emit — coverage was complete. One real bug in the mapping: `N7` was the
only slot that was not a site token, pure white in light and pure black in
dark, the latter reading as a hole punched in the warm dark paper. Pointed
them at `--card` and just under `--paper`. All 36 colours across the three
diagrams are now newsprint tokens, with no purple or Catppuccin left in
either scheme.

Light and dark verified on the home page and `/docs/architecture`.

Follow-on cards: auritus-f0ae14 (home page demo and hero copy) and
auritus-6e6e4d (diagram render reproducibility).

Leaving this open until the PR merges.
